```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

format_year <- function(year, df) {
  cat("## ", year, "\n\n")
  df %>% 
    filter(Year == year) %>% 
    pull(string) %>% 
    cat(sep = "\n")
}

df <- fromJSON("static/json/publications.json") %>%
  mutate(string = paste0(
    "### [", Title, "](", Link, ")\n",
    Authors, "\n\n",
    "::: { .callout-tip title='Abstract' collapse=true }\n\n", 
    Abstract, "\n\n:::\n\n",
    recycle0 = ""
  )) %>%
  arrange(desc(Year), Title)

map(unique(df$Year), format_year, df = df)
```
